problem_restatement: Test whether route-native close-only signals can replace blind time exits and whether configured price-bps stops are being whipsawed. Any wider stop must reduce notional enough to preserve the same modeled dollar barrier risk.
decision: Preserve all V61 live strategy, stop, target, profit-lock, sizing, leverage, and route-authority contracts. Do not promote SP500 or SNDK close-only opposite authority, and do not widen ETH or BTC stops. The evidence confirms some ETH tactical whipsaws but rejects static widening as a strategy-level improvement. Keep maximum hold as a fallback, retain the already-live route-specific exits, and make the next stop hypothesis a separately preregistered volatility/state contract with equal dollar risk.

confidence.blanket_static_stop_widening_rejection: high: exact historical ETH fixed-entry replay and current live path sensitivity point in the same direction
confidence.eth_tactical_whipsaw_exists: high for the seven observed stops: four recovered entry within fifteen minutes
confidence.future_volatility_state_stop_family: medium-low: mechanically plausible but not yet evaluated with causal ATR and untouched validation
confidence.long_run_strategy_profitability: low: historical and live windows are nonstationary and several route samples remain small

leverage_finding.claim: The V61 venue stop is calculated from fill price and price bps; leverage does not move that price barrier. Leverage multiplies return on margin and reduces liquidation headroom.
leverage_finding.eth_example: A 60-bps ETH price stop at 5x corresponds to approximately a 3 percent gross margin move before fees, slippage, funding, or gaps.
leverage_finding.falsifier: Update this finding if a live route is shown to derive its price stop from margin percentage or leverage rather than BoundExecutionPlan.stop_price.

ETH.four_hour_selection_bias: The comparison conditions on trades stopped by the 60-bps control and omits counterfactual fees, funding, slippage, and changed occupancy; it cannot authorize widening.
ETH.largest_winner_removed_failure: No wider candidate supplied a stable improvement over control in both partitions; several remained negative after the largest winner was removed.

BTC_robust_v3.live_path_result: The single loss crossed 75, 100, 125, and 150 bps and did not recover directionally by 24 hours.
BTC_robust_v3.smart_exit_verification: The V61 robust-v3 route binds btc_hulk_delayed_component_floor_v1; nineteen focused policy, controller, and V60/V61 inheritance tests passed.

SNDK.historical_proxy_limitation: The available proxy used a different 120-bps structural stop and provider signal exits rather than the V61 80-bps no-recipe contract.

BRENTOIL.resolved_long_result: The V58 long reached 105.83 bps MFE, then closed at the 24-hour fallback for -0.673366 USD net with no eligible opposite exit at close.
BRENTOIL.current_v61_short_status_at_disposition: open_and_protected; any profit-lock comparison is report-only and cannot be counted as a resolved lifecycle
BRENTOIL.prospective_evidence_limitation: The existing future-only registration is bound to the retired V58 run/profile identity and has not produced both-side resolved V61 evidence.

SOL_HYPE_SPCX.reason: No adequate current-strategy stopped-lifecycle sample supports a stop change; route-specific targets, recipe exits, opposite intents, regime extension, or fallbacks remain as configured.

failure_modes_and_tradeoffs: A wider stop can reduce tactical stop-outs while increasing time exposed to a genuinely invalid trade.
Equal-risk resizing lowers notional, so a wider stop can reduce profit dollars even when its raw price-bps result is higher.
Conditioning only on stopped trades creates selection bias and can make wider stops look better than strategy-level replay.
One-minute OHLC cannot prove private IOC fill price or intrabar event order.
Causal ATR was not recorded in the selected live entry contexts, so an ATR policy remains untested rather than rejected.
Nonstationary side and regime leadership can reverse between historical partitions and live windows.

The report-only research database sync exceeded its 300-second maintenance window during this pass; this limits newly materialized research views but did not stale the independently checked live checkpoint heartbeat.

next_validation.hypothesis: Use a causal volatility/structure stop sized to normal route noise, paired with lower notional and an explicit state/profit exit.
minimum_success_criteria: same modeled dollar barrier risk after notional resizing
positive after-cost development and untouched validation
improvement over control in both partitions
no worse maximum drawdown and nonnegative worst chronological fold
exact fees, funding, slippage, gap, occupancy, and stop precedence
next_validation.rollback: V61 remains the unchanged runtime control; no cutover or rollback is required from this disposition.

falsifiers: A source hash, route identity, signal timestamp, cost model, or stop-precedence mismatch changes the reproduced results.
A genuinely untouched equal-risk volatility/state challenger passes every frozen criterion in both partitions.
Live execution is shown to derive price stop distance from leverage or margin percentage.
A larger independent current-route sample reverses the whipsaw or strategy-level comparison.
